topic: New Year cards: asking {由紀|ゆき}
title_jp: {年賀状|ねんがじょう}って、どうするんだっけ？
context: Tuesday 8 December: the supermarket has started selling New Year postcards, and アルちゃん wants to send his first {年賀状|ねんがじょう}s. He asks {由紀|ゆき} on LINE when to post them and how to write them.
scene: Tuesday night. You bought New Year postcards but can't remember the rules. You ask {由紀|ゆき} on LINE.

phrases.jp: あれ、{今日|きょう}{何曜日|なんようび}だっけ？
phrases.en: Wait, what day is it again?
phrases.note: っけ: you knew it once and forgot. Very common out loud.

phrases.jp: {一言|ひとこと|a word, a short note|3}でも{手書き|てがき|handwritten|3}にするといいよ。
phrases.en: It's good to write at least a line by hand.

phrases.jp: {本年|ほんねん|this year (formal)|2}もよろしくお{願い|ねがい}いたします。
phrases.en: I look forward to your kindness this year too.
phrases.note: The set line on cards to teachers, bosses, hosts.

phrases.en: Happy New Year! Be good to me this year!
phrases.note: = あけましておめでとう + 今年もよろしく. Friends only, LINE style.

phrases.jp: {喪中|もちゅう|in mourning (that year)|2}の{人|ひと}には{出さない|ださない}ほうがいいですよ。
phrases.en: You'd better not send one to someone in mourning.
phrases.note: Families who lost someone that year send a {喪中|もちゅう}はがき in November or December instead.

dialogue_setting: A LINE chat with {由紀|ゆき} in Tokyo, Tuesday night, from under the kotatsu in {鷹ノ原|たかのはら}.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {由紀|ゆき}、{年賀状|ねんがじょう|New Year card|3}って、いつまでに{出す|だす}んだっけ？
dialogue.en: {由紀|ゆき}, when do you have to post New Year cards by, again?

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: 25{日|にち}くらいまでに{出せば|だせば}、{元日|がんじつ|New Year's Day|3}に{届く|とどく}よ！
dialogue.en: If you post them by about the 25th, they arrive on New Year's Day!

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: え、{誰|だれ}に{出す|だす}の？
dialogue.en: Wait, who are you sending them to?

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {田中|たなか}さんたちと{佐藤先生|さとうせんせい}。{手書き|てがき|handwritten|3}のほうがいいんだっけ？
dialogue.en: The {田中|たなか}s and {佐藤先生|さとうせんせい}. Handwritten is better, isn't it?

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: {一言|ひとこと|a word, a short note|3}だけでも{手書き|てがき}がいいよ。{印刷|いんさつ|printing|3}だけだと{冷たい|つめたい|cold (in feeling)|4}{感じ|かんじ|feeling, impression|4}
dialogue.en: Even just one line by hand is good. Only printed feels a bit cold.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: なるほど！レンにも{送った|おくった}ほうがいいかな？
dialogue.en: I see! Should I send one to レン too?

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: {住所|じゅうしょ}{聞く|きく}のはまだ{早い|はやい}ってｗ LINEのあけおめで{十分|じゅうぶん|enough|4}じゃん
dialogue.en: Asking for his address is too soon lol. A LINE 'Happy New Year' is plenty.

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: {私|わたし}は30{日|にち}から{実家|じっか|parents' home|4}に{帰る|かえる}〜！{年末|ねんまつ|end of the year|3}は{寝る|ねる}だけ！
dialogue.en: I'm going home to my parents' from the 30th! At year-end all I'll do is sleep!

listening.intro: Next morning at the post office, a poster announcement plays by the counter.
listening.title: {郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}のお{知らせ|しらせ}
listening.place: {鷹ノ原|たかのはら}{郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}

lines.jp: {年賀状|ねんがじょう|New Year card|3}は、25{日|にち}までにお{出し|だし}いただくと、{元日|がんじつ|New Year's Day|3}にお{届け|とどけ}できます。{年賀状|ねんがじょう}{専用|せんよう|special, only for|2}のポストにお{入れ|いれ}ください。
lines.en: If you post your New Year cards by the 25th, we can deliver them on New Year's Day. Please put them in the New-Year-card-only postbox.

listening.question: {元日|がんじつ}に{届けたい|とどけたい}とき、いつまでに{出しますか|だしますか}。
listening.explain: 25{日|にち}までにお{出|だ}しいただくと…{届|とど}けできます: post by the 25th.

grammar.form: noun / な-adj: + だっけ ({何曜日|なんようび}だっけ) · plain past + っけ ({言|い}ったっけ, {見|み}たっけ) · のだ: 〜んだっけ ({出|だ}すんだっけ, いいんだっけ) · polite: 〜でしたっけ ({何|なん}でしたっけ)
grammar.explanation: Add っけ when you once knew something and are trying to remember it: 'when was it again?'. It's casual and spoken; with people above you, use でしたっけ. Don't use it for things you never knew: then just ask 〜の？ or 〜ですか.

examples.jp: すみません、お{名前|なまえ}、{何|なん}でしたっけ？
examples.en: Sorry, what was your name again?

examples.jp: あれ、この{話|はなし}、もう{言った|いった}っけ？
examples.en: Hang on, did I already tell you this?

quiz.question: あれ、{澪|みお}の{面接|めんせつ}、{何曜日|なんようび}＿＿？
quiz.en: Hang on, what day was {澪|みお}'s interview again?
quiz.explain: After a noun, put だ before っけ: {何曜日|なんようび}だっけ.

quiz_more.question: {佐藤先生|さとうせんせい}、{冬休み|ふゆやすみ}は{何日|なんにち}から＿＿？
quiz_more.en: {佐藤先生|さとうせんせい}, what date did winter break start from again?
quiz_more.explain: To a teacher, the polite form: noun + でしたっけ. だっけ is too casual.

quiz_more.question: この{映画|えいが}、{前|まえ}に{一緒|いっしょ}に{見た|みた}＿＿？
quiz_more.en: Did we see this film together before?
quiz_more.explain: Plain past + っけ directly: {見|み}たっけ. No だ after a verb.

kanji.where: Printed in gold on the New Year postcards on sale at the supermarket.
kanji.breakdown: {謹賀新年|きんがしんねん}: 謹 respectfully + 賀 celebrate + 新年 new year → 'I respectfully celebrate the New Year'.
kanji.related: {年賀状|ねんがじょう} uses the same 賀. Short form on casual cards: {賀正|がしょう}.

tip.title: Words to avoid on a {年賀状|ねんがじょう}
tip.body: Write {昨年|さくねん} (last year), not {去年|きょねん}: 去 means 'leave', and that's bad luck at New Year. And {元旦|がんたん} already means the morning of 1 January, so '1{月|がつ}1{日|にち}{元旦|がんたん}' says it twice.

challenge.prompt: Thursday is the {白馬|はくば} ski day, but you've forgotten the meeting time. Ask {健太|けんた} on LINE what time you were meeting again.
challenge.model_answer: {白馬|はくば}の{日|ひ}、{集合|しゅうごう|meeting up (time)|3}{何時|なんじ}だっけ？
challenge.explanation: {集合|しゅうごう} is the word for a group's meeting time or place. {何時|なんじ} is a noun question, so it takes だっけ, which tells {健太|けんた} you knew it once and forgot. Casual is right between coworkers your age.

vocab.note: {年|ねん} year + {賀|が} celebrate + {状|じょう} letter. {年賀状|ねんがじょう}を{出|だ}す = send one.
{元|がん} origin + {日|じつ} day. A national holiday.
{手|て} hand + {書|か}く write. Feels warmer than printed.
{一言|ひとこと}でも = even just a word.
{印刷|いんさつ}する = to print. At a konbini: コピー{機|き}で{印刷|いんさつ}.
Water or a person. Cold weather is {寒|さむ}い.
〜{感|かん}じ = 'it feels kind of…'. {感|かん}じがいい = pleasant.
Same kanji as 10 minutes (じゅっぷん): read by context.
Where you grew up. {実家|じっか}に{帰|かえ}る for New Year and Obon.

kanji_study.parts: A hand on the left pressing down on a kneeling person on the right (卩) → pressing down to leave a mark: a seal, a stamp.
宀 roof + 三 + 人 → a house full of real goods, like ripe fruit: fruit, and what's real and true.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 美 (beautiful): 美 has 羊 sheep on top, 実 has 宀 a roof.
